turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

Here’s how our shipping works:

Where we ship
We do not currently ship worldwide. Our shipping areas are:

Contiguous United States: all products
Alaska & Hawaii: select products
Canada: select items, to limited regions only

We do not ship to other international locations outside the US and Canada.

Customs, duties, and taxes for Canada
For eligible Canadian orders:

All required fees, duties, taxes, and certifications are already included in the pricing and shipping charges shown at checkout.
You do not need to arrange your own phytosanitary certificates or pay additional customs or duty fees on delivery.

If you tell me what country you’re in and what you’re hoping to order, I can let you know whether it’s something we can ship to you and what to expect at checkout.

How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping has two parts: when we ship and how long it’s in transit.

When your order ships At checkout, you’ll pick an estimated delivery timeframe from our calendar (or, if you use Shop Pay/PayPal, the system will assign one automatically based on your location and planting season). We prepare and ship your order to match that timeframe.

Time in transit Once the box leaves our nursery:

Within the contiguous US: transit is typically about 1–5 business days.
Canada (where available): orders usually arrive the week after your selected ship week.

You’ll get a tracking email as soon as your package is scanned by the carrier so you can follow it the rest of the way.
